text:
the way u frame procrastination is:

"tomorrow, I am magically going to have the discipline to do something...despite that I dont have this discipline right now."

and then u can label it, like, what is that behavior?

its some mix of arrogance and delusion. plus u can look back on ur own track record of "how often have I followed thru on this?" chances are the track record is putrid

over 3-6 months u can put any new habit in place, or train instinctual responses/self-talk...in this case it should be revulsion, some sense of disgust with yourself and mediocrity and weakness in general

something like "nah we aint doing that" is enough, and then before u can think abt the task itself...u just run towards it.
